'''Jason Beyer''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 6th at [[May 2000 Mount Prospect tournament]] on 20 May 2000 with [[This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time / Pray I Don't Alter It Any Further|TDIGWATT (Dark Deal)]], according to Steve Kuperman's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d780">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-21-mt-prospect-illinois-5-20-2000d780/ mt-prospect-illinois-5-20-2000], DeckTech (Steve "Crazy Hermit" Kuperman, 21 May 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-21-mt-prospect-illinois-5-20-2000d780/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
